rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This PayPal Java MCP server implementation provides tools for analyzing and improving payment processing, including authorization rate analysis and a basic calculator. It supports both REST API and JSON-RPC over stdio interfaces, making it versatile for web clients and Smithery integration. The server is containerized with Docker support, facilitating easy deployment and scalability for various payment processing use cases.
